verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Close serves a live llms.txt at developer.close.com with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. The docs also say appending .md to any page URL returns clean Markdown, and the cited .md doc pages (API overview, resources, changelog) plus a published OpenAPI spec back this up as agent-consumable documentation. The root-path .md probe returned a soft 404 page, but that is an edge case, not a contradiction. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs, evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
